tasks.title: Build three more pieces
tasks.detail: Log each one. Try one variation: size or wood.

tasks.title: Pick a 12 V UL-listed pump for about 18 in of lift
tasks.detail: Size the flow to the spill-lip width; check reviews for noise.

tasks.title: Photograph the pieces
tasks.detail: Natural light, water running, one shot in a styled setting.

tasks.title: Apply to one spring market
tasks.detail: For example Edgewater Public Market Second Fridays, about a mile away.

tasks.title: Write the care card
tasks.detail: Distilled water, clean every 1–2 weeks, never run dry, keep moss dry.

tasks.title: Take the intro woodshop class
Show a piece to one local shop
tasks.detail: For example Jolly Goods on Tennyson, or I Heart Denver (artist keeps 70%).

tasks.title: Sell your first fountain
Recover the logo files from ChatGPT
tasks.detail: Master files and brand guide are still missing from 2025.

tasks.title: Choose the first place to sell
tasks.detail: A local market, a consignment shop, or directly to people you know.

tasks.title: Design the care card and price tag
Visit Clear Creek Makerspace
tasks.detail: 9110 W 44th Ave, Wheat Ridge. $60/mo; intro classes mostly free.

tasks.title: Sketch the indoor cascade with real dimensions
tasks.detail: About 14–18 in tall, 9–11 in wide. Mark shelf heights and the spill lip.

tasks.title: Build prototype 1
Book a free Colorado SBDC session
tasks.detail: Pricing, licensing and bookkeeping questions. Hosted at Red Rocks CC.

tasks.title: Choose the wood: aspen or white oak
tasks.detail: Both work indoors once sealed.

tasks.title: Build prototype 2 with the fixes
Set up a simple photo corner
tasks.detail: Window light, a plain backdrop, a phone tripod.

tasks.title: Run it for a week and listen
tasks.detail: Quiet-room sound, splash, and water lost.

tasks.title: Look back at both logs
tasks.detail: What sold, what people asked about, what took longest.

tasks.title: Set your price from the build log
tasks.detail: Use average hours and materials below. Range to test: $175–300.

tasks.title: Set up a way to take card payments
Drill a test stone wet with diamond bits
tasks.detail: Practice on cheap stones before good ones.

tasks.title: Practice simple box joinery on scrap
Get liability insurance quotes
tasks.detail: Markets usually require $1M coverage; about $200–400 a year.

tasks.title: Start a tumbler batch for the base stones
tasks.detail: Keep one batch running from here on.

tasks.title: Tune the spill lip and shelf spacing
tasks.detail: Small angle changes change the sound a lot.

tasks.title: Plumb a hidden tub, pump and tubing
tasks.detail: Make the pump easy to lift out for cleaning.

tasks.title: Set up simple bookkeeping
tasks.detail: A spreadsheet of money in and out is enough to start.

tasks.title: Test waterproof finishes on offcuts
tasks.detail: Leave samples wet for a week and compare.

tasks.title: Lend one to a friend for two weeks
tasks.detail: A real home trial before strangers see it.

tasks.title: Visit the Denver Gem & Mineral Guild
tasks.detail: Meets in Wheat Ridge on 2nd Fridays, Sep–May. Ask about lapidary equipment.

tasks.title: Get a Colorado sales tax license
tasks.detail: $16 for two years.

tasks.title: Pick one place to show your work online
Mock up a booth table at home
tasks.detail: Fountains running, small items in front, price tags visible.

tasks.title: Write a one-line description of Arnfjäll
Wire a 12 V LED strip to share one plug with the pump
Buy materials for two prototypes
tasks.detail: Wood, slate pieces, small tub, pump, LED strip, sealer, stones.
